purpose: Classify the first non-triangular complementary-cycle atom in the graphic AF3/tension frontier. A properly coloured C4 has exactly six normalized tension states, and these are exactly the six bases of U_{2,4}. Then prove by an explicit 8-vertex control and cycle-space dimension that solving the Hamiltonian cycle and complementary C4 cycles independently is incomplete: the missing information is a linear-size family of mixed-cycle equations.

c4_local_classification.setup: Let C=(v0,v1,v2,v3,v0) be an oriented 4-cycle and let c:V(C)->GF(3) be proper. Define t_i=c(v_{i+1})-c(v_i) in GF(3)^*={+1,-1}.
c4_local_classification.theorem: For four signs t_i in {+1,-1}, sum_i t_i=0 mod 3 iff exactly two signs are +1 and exactly two are -1.
c4_local_classification.proof: If k entries are +1 then the integer signed sum is k-(4-k)=2k-4. Modulo 3 this vanishes iff 2k=1 mod 3, hence k=2 for 0<=k<=4.
c4_local_classification.matroid_form: Let b_i=1 iff t_i=-1. Then the feasible supports {i:b_i=1} are exactly the six 2-subsets of {0,1,2,3}, i.e. the bases of the uniform matroid U_{2,4}.
c4_local_classification.colour_state_count: There are 18 labelled proper 3-colourings of C4. Fixing c(v0)=0 leaves exactly six, in bijection with the U_{2,4} bases.
c4_local_classification.orbit_structure: The affine colour group AGL(1,3) of size six acts freely on the 18 labelled colourings, leaving exactly three structural orbits: both opposite pairs equal, only v0=v2, or only v1=v3.

exact_block_csp_view.component_state: For a complementary C4 component, store one of its 18 labelled proper colourings as a constant-domain state.
exact_block_csp_view.hamiltonian_constraint: Every Hamiltonian edge joining port p of one C4 block to port q of another imposes only the binary condition colour_p != colour_q on the two block states.
exact_block_csp_view.equivalence: When the complementary 2-factor consists of C4 components, global 3-colouring is exactly the corresponding constant-domain binary CSP over these block states. This is a representation theorem only; the hard source prevents treating constant local domain as tractability.

mixed_cycle_barrier.dimension: For a connected 4-regular graph on n vertices, |E|=2n and the GF(3) cycle-space dimension is |E|-|V|+1=n+1.
mixed_cycle_barrier.factor_cycles: If the complementary 2-factor consists of r=n/4 disjoint C4 components, the Hamiltonian cycle plus the r complementary cycles provide only r+1=n/4+1 independent factor-cycle equations because their edge supports are pairwise disjoint.
mixed_cycle_barrier.missing_dimension: At least (n+1)-(n/4+1)=3n/4 independent mixed-cycle equations remain. Therefore independent satisfaction of every factor-cycle tension equation does not establish that the edge signs form a global tension.

facts: The three cycles are edge-disjoint and their union is a connected simple 4-regular graph.
The Hamiltonian C8 admits a nowhere-zero sign pattern with four +1 and four -1 and hence zero GF(3) cycle sum.
Each complementary C4 independently admits a U_{2,4} sign pattern with two +1 and two -1.
Nevertheless exhaustive exact enumeration finds no proper 3-colouring, so no combined locally-valid sign choice can satisfy all mixed-cycle equations as a global tension.

search_complexity_firewall.cycle_plus_triangles: The existence theorem for cycle-plus-triangles graphs is not a licensed polynomial witness terminal: the classical proofs are non-algorithmic, and modern work on constrained/fair independent sets in cycles places closely related guaranteed search problems in PPA-complete territory.
search_complexity_firewall.hard_side: Fleischner-Sabidussi show NP-completeness persists for 4-regular Hamiltonian graphs whose complementary components are non-selfcrossing cycles of fixed constant length at least four. Thus constant component size and noncrossing-within-component structure do not by themselves yield a solver.

positive: The first non-triangular local tension atom is completely classified and is matroidal: U_{2,4}.
The exact residual is isolated as compatibility of these local bases with the mixed graphic cycle equations.
A constant-domain C4-block CSP representation is available for finite-state experiments without expanding vertex colourings globally.
killed: Check only the Hamiltonian cycle equation and each complementary cycle equation independently.
Infer global tension existence merely from the local U_{2,4} matroid bases.
Treat cycle-plus-triangles existence as a polynomial reconstruction subroutine without an actual constructive algorithm.
not_killed: A polynomial contraction of the mixed-cycle equations exploiting interlacement/conformal ordering.
A signed-graphic or regular-matroid augmentation that couples U_{2,4} blocks globally.
A nonlocal determinant/Pfaffian/cancellation identity for the mixed-cycle system.
